items.title: PayPo Taps Citigroup and JPMorgan for Possible Warsaw IPO
items.why: Public BNPL listings would provide valuation comps for installment partnership pricing discussions.
items.summary_ai: Polish BNPL firm PayPo is reportedly preparing a Warsaw IPO with Citi, JPMorgan Chase and Ipopema as advisers.
items.take: Public BNPL listings would provide valuation comps for installment partnership pricing discussions.
items.low_confidence: Based on Bloomberg report citing unnamed sources
